title: Act II, Scene IV
focus: wit, the Nurse and the wedding plan

teacherSummary.text: Benvolio and Mercutio learn that Tybalt has sent Romeo a challenge; Mercutio mocks Tybalt's fencing. Romeo joins them and wins a battle of puns. The Nurse arrives, is mocked by Mercutio, and receives Romeo's message: Juliet should come to Friar Laurence's cell that afternoon to be married.
